notes: Ichidan verb. Takes を or に for the place or person visited (Sense 1), and が for the season or occasion that arrives (Sense 2).
More formal and literary than 行く (to go) or 訪問する (to visit officially); often used in writing and news.

senses.definition: Of a season, time, or state: to arrive or come.

notes: This verb implies a purposeful visit to a place or a person. It is often used for travel destinations or social calls.
Unlike the common '行く' (iku - to go), '訪れる' has a slightly more formal or literary tone, often suggesting that the place visited is significant or worthy of attention.
